meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动化实验室数据管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Benchling平台上自动化处理实验数据与库存。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data management on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate lab data and inventory operations on Benchling.

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 Benchling API 自动管理生物序列、样本、实验记录、工作流等实验室数据，并查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求访问或操作 Benchling 平台的数据（如创建序列、管理库存、生成实验记录）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个名为“My Plasmid”的DNA序列，碱基为ATCGATCG。
查询库存中所有盒子及其位置。
say.note: Claude 会列出库存容器和位置信息。

say.text: 为昨天的实验创建一个ELN条目，链接相关的序列。
say.note: Claude 会创建实验记录并与实体关联。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate Benchling lab data management including registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, and Data Warehouse queries via the Python SDK and REST API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to access or operate Benchling platform data, such as creating sequences, managing inventory, or generating lab notebook entries.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named 'My Plasmid' with bases ATCGATCG.
say_en.note: Claude will call Benchling API to create the sequence.

say_en.text: List all boxes and their locations in inventory.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve inventory containers and locations.

say_en.text: Create an ELN entry for yesterday's experiment and link relevant sequences.
say_en.note: Claude will create an entry and associate entities.
